identityScopeNotes: The nationwide amputee-survey source (PMID 34583023, introduced in ME-30 for amputation-of-arm) was reused across the three additional limb-level amputation identities rather than duplicated as separate source entities; the pending-verification entity now carries four live uses.

anal-fissure and ankle-disarticulation were deferred to the next batch pending a credible condition-specific target and citation.
